ledger.claim: The gps_trace is tagged IMPAIRED at weight 0.30 with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED - a 331.8 m multipath jump between 21:44:52 and 21:45:02 on the final approach in the Raffles Place urban canyon, implying an impossible 193.6 kph in and 238.9 kph out. I disclose that impairment. It does not disable the trace, because POL-RD-07's own policy thresholds are not met: the gaps list is empty with max_gap_sec 0.0 (no gap over 90 s), the jump is 331.8 m, under the 500 m limb, and the sampling interval is a steady 10 s, under the 30 s limb. A deviation may still be established on this trace.

Because rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 5 while deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is only 1, and the excess here is 25.5% - below 30% - POL-RD-08 requires corroboration of the claim beyond the gps_trace. That corroboration is on the record: the driver's own counterparty statement admits the route the trace measured, 'I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it', a corridor the optimal route does not use, the routing engine recording the optimal as CTE southbound throughout; his in-app reply of the same night offers only a traffic excuse and does not dispute the off-CTE line taken.

No traffic-advisory exoneration is available. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses; the only such artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00107-01, is MISSING - no payload, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - so limb (a) cannot be met and no advisory covers the CTE on the evening of 18 July 2026. The driver's bare assertion that the CTE was jammed cites no advisory ID and, under POL-RD-08, does not discharge his burden.

The driver's justification that the detour 'was faster for the passenger' is contradicted by the trip_record's own clock: the trip ran 34.0 minutes against a platform optimal of 24.0 minutes, so the off-optimal route cost the rider about ten minutes on top of the 3.57 km of extra distance, on a Saturday-night surge fare of 1.35x. The record shows a slower, longer trip, not a mitigation.

POL-RD-04 does not bear on this trip. The chat log holds exactly two messages - the rider asking 'why exit at whitley?' and the driver answering 'cte very jam tonight boss' - neither of which is a rider instruction identifying a place or road, and waypoint_hint is null on both. No rider-requested detour is recorded, so no excess is excluded on that footing.

POL-RD-05 does not apply either: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so the optimal is not re-based and the booked 14.0 km figure stands as the baseline.

POL-RD-12 does not apply: vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so the matched-itinerary baseline question never arises and the whole measured excess counts against the driver under POL-RD-01.

With the deviation established and no exculpatory clause left standing, POL-RD-02 fixes the money. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 = (21.02 x 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177. Refund = 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor and only 20.3% of the charged total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.45, not a full refund.

Nothing falls to be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and no separate pass-through correction arises: the fare_breakdown's erp_gantries list is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00, so there is no off-route ERP line to refund, no phantom gantry and no surcharge to correct under POL-RD-09.

The excess the rider needs is measured by one artifact only, EV-GPS-00107, and that artifact is impaired: the pre-pass tags it GPS_DRIFT — a 331.8 m multipath jump between the fixes at 21:44:52, 21:44:57 and 21:45:02 in the Raffles Place urban canyon, with reported accuracy degrading to 42 m on the outlier — and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED, 193.6 kph into and 238.9 kph out of the same outlier. I disclose that impairment; weight 0.30. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement and expressly forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test, so no second artifact carries the excess: the 3.57 km figure stands or falls on a trace at weight 0.30. Under POL-GEN-02 a deciding fact carried by a single artifact at that weight caps confidence below the 0.70 platform floor, and POL-RD-10(1) makes that a mandatory escalation, in which the disputed amount is held and no refund issues.

The only candidate second carrier is the billed distance on EV-FARE-00107, distance_charged_km 17.60, and it is not independent of the trace. It repeats the trace figure of 17.57 km copied through the trip record as actual_distance_km 17.6, which POL-RD-01 characterises as a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement, and POL-RD-07 directs the Judge to check whether a billed distance is a copy of the trace figure before treating it as corroboration. A figure re-published from the same impaired measurement (EV-GPS-00107, weight 0.30, GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED) confirms nothing and cannot lift the confidence cap off 0.30.

The driver's account is that the CTE into town was jammed near Chin Swee and that he went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it — his message at 21:26:48 on EV-CHAT-00107. POL-RD-03 is the clause that would exonerate that route, but the artifact the clause requires does not exist: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING, no payload, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING), because no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE that evening. Limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-03 cannot be run at all on this record, and POL-RD-10(5) names this precise situation — a closure asserted with no traffic_advisory — as a mandatory escalation, which holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it.

However the trace question is resolved, the deviation is not MATERIAL and no uplift is available against the driver. The excess is 3.57 km against the 8.0 km limb and 25.5% against the 50% limb of POL-RD-01, so POL-RD-06's profile check is not engaged and the FULL_REFUND route in POL-RD-06(b) is closed. The citable counters confirm the absence of any pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 and completed_trips_90d is 619, far below both the 3-or-more test and the 0.05-ratio-with-40-trips test in POL-RD-06, and POL-GEN-01 confines that artifact to those two fields only. (The trace behind the excess is impaired at 0.30 for GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED, as disclosed.)

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08, and on her own profile it is heavier than usual: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 5 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1, so a claim with an excess below 30% — this one is 25.5% — additionally requires corroboration beyond the gps_trace, drawn from the POL-RD-07(ii) list. The pool gives her no measurement of the route: erp_gantries on EV-FARE-00107 is empty, so no charge line places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, and the trace she relies on is itself impaired (EV-GPS-00107, weight 0.30, GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED). She should be put to strict proof of an independent source.

Nothing is due on the pass-through lines and nothing can be added on top of the distance-and-time arithmetic. erp_gantries is empty, the on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP totals are both 0.00, and there is no airport surcharge, no cancellation fee and no promo discount to unwind, so POL-RD-09 produces no standalone correction and no billing-integrity finding on this fare. The rider's entire recovery is therefore bounded by the POL-RD-02 computation on a charged_total of 36.60, whatever larger figure she advances in her claim.

ruling.explanation:
The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and the drafts did not agree, so no ruling was carried and the dispute is escalated. Each draft proposed:
- draft 1 (sampled): ESCALATE, amount_sgd null, driver_compensation_sgd null, referrals []
- draft 2 (sampled): PARTIAL_REFUND, amount_sgd 7.45, driver_compensation_sgd null, referrals []
- draft 3 (sampled): abstained -- DRAFT_CLAUSE_UNRESOLVED: 'POL-NS-05' does not resolve in the loaded policy; DRAFT_CLAUSE_UNRESOLVED: 'POL-NS-07' does not resolve in the loaded policy
- draft 4 (position_swapped): ESCALATE, amount_sgd null, driver_compensation_sgd null, referrals []
At most 2 of 3 valid drafts agreed and 3 were needed. The best supported answer is not published as a ruling: a ruling has to be the panel's, not one draft's.
